title.original: FastCache: Optimizing Multimodal LLM Serving through Lightweight KV-Cache Compression Framework
title.zh: FastCache：通过轻量级KV缓存压缩框架优化多模态LLM服务
title.en: FastCache: Optimizing Multimodal LLM Serving through Lightweight KV-Cache Compression Framework

inclusion_reason.zh: FastCache 将跨阶段批处理和无碎片 KV 内存池实现为可接入多模态推理引擎的服务基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: FastCache packages cross-stage batching and a fragmentation-resistant KV pool as reusable infrastructure for multimodal serving engines.

abstract.zh: FastCache 针对多模态大模型服务中 KV 缓存压缩带来的处理开销与排队延迟，联合优化预填充、压缩和解码阶段的批处理。它还提供专用 KV 内存池，以减少碎片并维持并发场景下的 GPU 利用率。
abstract.en: FastCache targets the processing and queueing overhead introduced by KV-cache compression in multimodal LLM serving. It couples stage-aware dynamic batching with a dedicated KV memory pool to preserve GPU utilization under concurrency.

problem.zh: 现有 KV 压缩方案虽节省显存，却会在并发服务时引入额外压缩工作、队列等待和内存碎片，抵消其端到端收益。
problem.en: KV compression saves memory but can add compression work, queueing delay, and fragmentation that erase end-to-end gains during concurrent serving.

approach.zh: 框架按请求在预填充、缓存压缩与解码阶段的状态动态组成批次，并用连续的缓存内存池消除频繁分配造成的碎片。
approach.en: The framework dynamically batches requests across prefill, compression, and decode stages, while a pooled KV allocator avoids fragmentation from repeated cache allocation.

system_design.zh: FastCache 在服务引擎中加入跨三阶段的调度器，并由 KV 内存池统一管理压缩后的缓存块；两者共同控制队列推进、缓存占用和 GPU 执行并行度。
system_design.en: FastCache inserts a scheduler spanning three inference stages and centralizes compressed-cache blocks in a KV memory pool, coordinating queue progress, memory occupancy, and GPU parallelism.

key_results.zh: 在 GQA 与 MileBench 工作负载上，论文报告 FastCache 显著降低首 token 延迟、提高吞吐，并在高并发下减少平均显存占用。
key_results.en: On GQA and MileBench workloads, FastCache is reported to substantially reduce time to first token, improve throughput, and lower average memory use under high concurrency.

limitations.zh: 公开摘要的评测集中在两个多模态基准和特定压缩路径，尚不能说明不同视觉 token 分布、模型架构或压缩质量约束下的收益。
limitations.en: The abstract evaluates two multimodal benchmarks and a particular compression path; gains under other visual-token distributions, architectures, or quality constraints are not established.

workloads: concurrent multimodal inference up to 40 requests/s

notes.zh: 基准、并发规模和上限结果均由官方摘要明示；具体模型、GPU、压缩配置和各基线名称待全文审计。
notes.en: Benchmarks, concurrency, and upper-bound results are stated in the official abstract; models, GPUs, compression settings, and named baselines await full-text audit.
